kind: mh-install: download a static tool and run it by name (emulator and real device)
mechanism: download with curl, extract tar.gz/apk with gzip+tar, store under /usr/lib/mh-tools/<name>/tool, write /usr/bin/<name> python shim that runs mh-exec through /usr/bin/python3
shimFinding: shell shims (both exec and non-exec) crashed with SIGSEGV at exit after a successful run because the PRoot loader state does not survive nesting sh -> python3; a python-shebang shim that runs mh-exec in-process exits cleanly (0)
